title: A remote erase while a My health sheet is up (Settings, an edit sheet, a value page's sheet, upload) raises the questions cover under that sheet
evidence: From the owner's review of S48. ios/HealthRoadmap/App/RootView.swift recordChanged runs Cover.onRecordChange, which waits only for the backup Offer and this phone's own erase. An erase from another device that lands while a sheet opened by MyDataView is up (Settings, an edit sheet, a value page's sheet, the lab upload) sends .erased at once, and the root fullScreenCover is asked to present under that sheet. The eraser's hold (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/DataEraser.swift:81, holdsRemoteErases) covers only this phone's own erase. RootView's quiet (window.rootViewController.presentedViewController == nil) can be checked but not observed, so nothing would call recordChanged again when the sheet closes. Fix: MyDataView reports when its sheets close (as settingsClosed does for Settings), and recordChanged waits on that too, with a table test. Verify at batch end: a remote erase while each My health sheet is up. US-25 AC16d
